title: Day job with Lawrence Marrero
summary: He and Lawrence worked day jobs at Holtzman's store but always got off in time to play at night.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Well back to this day job, it seems to me Lawrence used to work with you on the same day.
Me and Lawrence used to work in the front of the store. Worked for Holtzman at 510 Frenchman Street.
But that was hard work, huh? No, not hard work. Not for you.

No, not for Lawrence. And then after he went out, we went out, Lawrence went away, we'd come back. I was playing every night so I just got out to the front of the business, come back and got me back to another place. I came with cats. You know? When I do my work and I had plenty to do, but it never interfered with my playing. I'd always get off time enough to go ahead and do my playing. Because every time you pick up the paper you'd see a writer in there about us, you know?
